crash_head: Every market collapsed — bitcoin, stocks and the underworld are all falling
boom_head: A golden age has begun — bitcoin, stocks and the underworld are all soaring
crash_body: Every market shakes the server at once. Buyers get bargains now — anyone in debt is in trouble.
boom_body: Every market soars at once. Sellers make a killing now — but the golden age won't last forever.
footer: Nobody knows how long it will last
